headline_item.title_zh: 微软宣布将于2027年停用To Do应用
headline_item.title_en: Microsoft plans to retire its To Do app on June 30, 2027, offering migration to Planner for work and school accounts, but no replacement for personal accounts (Todd Bishop/GeekWire)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 微软计划在2027年6月30日正式关闭To Do应用，企业用户将迁移至Planner，个人用户尚无替代方案
headline_item.event_summary_en: Microsoft announced the retirement of the To Do app effective June 30, 2027. Work and school accounts will transition tasks to Planner, while personal account users currently lack a replacement strategy, raising concerns over data migration and feature parity.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】微软公司（Microsoft）在Microsoft Ignite年度技术大会：宣布停用To Do应用，并将其工作负载整合至Planner
【起因与机理】旨在将个人与团队任务统一底层架构，以适配Copilot及AI智能体调度
【核心事实细节】微软将于2027年6月30日终止To Do应用服务。
【各方立场与态度】此次整合旨在将个人任务纳入Copilot智能体调度框架。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Microsoft (Microsoft Ignite Conference): Plan to deprecate To Do and consolidate workloads into Planner
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To unify task management architecture for Copilot and AI agent integration
[Key Metrics] Reber and his co-founders sold Wunderlist’s parent company, 6Wunderkinder, to Microsoft in 2015 for a reported $100 million to $200 million.
[Key Position & Outlook] Consolidation aims to integrate task management into Copilot AI agent ecosystem.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 此举揭示了微软在AI时代对生产力软件架构的深度重构，即以‘智能体为中心’取代以‘轻量级应用为中心’的逻辑。通过牺牲用户体验的连续性以强制整合底层数据库，微软意在降低Copilot调用个人任务数据的技术门槛，但这也反映了其在AI战略激进推进中，对存量用户粘性与功能兼容性博弈的忽视。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This move signals a strategic shift towards an 'agent-centric' architecture, prioritizing AI-integrated workflows over standalone lightweight applications. By forcing data consolidation into Planner to lower technical barriers for Copilot, Microsoft is betting that AI-driven utility will outweigh the churn risk from sacrificing legacy user experience continuity.

headlines.title_zh: 美新版半导体出口管制扩大覆盖至消费电子芯片
headlines.title_en: Industry insiders say new US export rules affect a broader range of chips, including SoCs used in consumer electronics, extending beyond advanced AI chips (Cheng Ting-Fang/Nikkei Asia)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 美国商务部将出口管制门槛下调至14/16纳米节点，导致台积电暂停向部分消费电子及汽车芯片厂商出货以进行合规核查
headlines.event_summary_en: The U.S. Department of Commerce has expanded export controls to include chips produced at or below the 14/16nm process node, affecting mobile SoCs, automotive, and consumer electronics chips. TSMC, the world’s largest foundry, has halted shipments to various chip developers in China and Southeast Asia to conduct mandatory regulatory compliance reviews.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国商务部、台积电、小米及各类消费电子与自动驾驶芯片设计商：出口管制门槛降至14/16纳米，暂停交付非白名单客户的消费级芯片
【起因与机理】旨在通过更广泛的制程节点锁定，阻断全球先进代工产能向目标国家转移
【关键数据与实测】管制门槛由高性能AI芯片下调至14/16纳米全类芯片。
【行业影响与走向】产业链影响从AI中心延伸至智能手机及自动驾驶等消费领域。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] U.S. Department of Commerce, TSMC, Xiaomi, and various consumer/automotive chip developers: Reduced export control threshold to 14/16nm nodes and suspended shipments to non-whitelisted entities
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To restrict access to advanced process nodes and curb the development of domestic high-end computing capabilities globally
[Key Metrics] Export control threshold lowered from AI-specific chips to all 14/16nm nodes.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Supply chain impact spreads from AI data centers to smartphone and automotive sectors.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此举标志着美方对华半导体封锁逻辑从‘性能导向’转向‘物理节点导向’的全面覆盖，通过卡死14纳米以上先进制程，迫使全球代工厂剥离非美国背景客户。这对消费电子供应链而言是结构性利空，将极大提升芯片设计的合规成本，并加速东南亚等新兴市场在半导体自主化进程中的战略收缩。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This shift from performance-based restrictions to node-based physical constraints marks an attempt to decouple global foundries from non-U.S. aligned developers. The move significantly raises compliance burdens across the consumer electronics value chain and will likely force a consolidation of design ambitions in emerging Asian semiconductor markets.

headlines.title_zh: 育碧成立Motherbrain子公司深耕AI生成式NPC
headlines.title_en: Ubisoft launches Motherbrain, a subsidiary focused on developing "smart NPCs with memory and AI game masters that manage large-scale systemic worlds" (Sophie McEvoy/GamesIndustry.biz)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 育碧正式组建全资子公司Motherbrain，旨在研发具备记忆功能的智能NPC及管理大规模系统化世界的AI游戏引擎
headlines.event_summary_en: Ubisoft has launched its subsidiary Motherbrain, integrating the generative AI team behind the Teammates project to develop smart NPCs with long-term memory and autonomous systemic world-management engines. The subsidiary intends to provide technical support for internal Creative House workflows while seeking external strategic partnerships.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】育碧（Ubisoft）及其首席执行官Yves Guillemot在公司2024/25财年上半年财报会议：成立AI研发子公司Motherbrain，旨在开发具备长期记忆的NPC与系统化世界管理AI
【起因与机理】通过生产力工具升级弥补开发周期与运营成本压力，同时配合近期生产环境的人员结构性调整
【关键数据与实测】同步执行蒙特利尔与魁北克工作室约166人的裁员以优化资源分配。
【各方立场与态度】核心技术栈锁定智能NPC记忆系统与大规模世界自动化管理。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Ubisoft and CEO Yves Guillemot (H1 Financial Results announcement): Launched Motherbrain to develop smart NPCs and large-scale systemic world-management AI
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To optimize production workflows amidst staff layoffs and drive long-term immersive experience innovation
[Key Metrics] biz understands, the cuts accounted for less than 4% of the studios' total headcount and included members of Vantage Studios.
[Key Position & Outlook] Concurrent layoffs of 166 staff across Montreal and Quebec studios to realign resources.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 育碧此举显示其正试图从单纯的数字内容生产商转向AI基础设施提供商，利用AI介入底层逻辑架构来降低高成本3A游戏的可持续运营压力。在进行规模性人员裁撤的同时高调注资AI子公司，反映出其将核心生产要素从人力密集型转向模型驱动型的紧迫商业转型意图。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Ubisoft's strategy marks a transition from a pure content producer to an AI-infrastructure player, aiming to mitigate the unsustainable operational costs of 3A games via systemic AI logic. By coupling headcount reductions with dedicated AI investment, the firm is signaling a forced migration from labor-intensive development toward model-driven production workflows.

titans.name: Yann LeCun
titans.role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
titans.event_context_zh:
纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
titans.event_context_en: @int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify a
titans.quote_zh:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun 正则化器只是指定归纳偏差的一种方法。

您的模型架构和您使用的优化过程已经存在归纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
titans.quote_en:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify an inductive bias.

The architecture of your model, and the optimization procedure you use already have inductive biases: they like to produce certain functions more than others.

A regularizer merely imposes another bias.

Learning theory tells you that you have to have an inductive bias, otherwise you can't learn anything with a reasonable number of samples or trials (VC theory, no free lunch theorems).

So, conceptually, theoretically, philosophically, and practically, there is nothing wrong with regularizers.
